name: cauce. buildings (Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0, ZMG AOI)
description: Building footprints for the ZMG AOI bbox [-103.75,20.25,-103.05,21.0] as Mapbox Vector Tiles, layer 'buildings', z14-15 (overzoom beyond 15). Properties: s = primary source (1 OpenStreetMap, 2 Microsoft ML Buildings, 3 Google Open Buildings, 4 Esri Community Maps, 5 other); h = Overture height in m and f = floors (only when present, ~0.5%); hn = median INEGI DSM-DTM (m) over the footprint's 5 m cells, an ESTIMATE from satellite photogrammetry that includes trees and noise, not a measured building height; c = Overture class when present.
